description: The experiment record from Del's LABORATORY spec (section 8, 'Experiment tracking and reproducibility'). Every run files one, including failed runs: a failed hypothesis is scientific information, and deleting a failure is falsification. evidence_level is capped by what verification has actually run, structurally: an experiment record produced by this system can never carry a level above 3 (levels 4 to 6 require physical experiments by qualified humans), and the allOf rules below cap an unverified or mismatched result at level 2. Only an independent re-execution, recorded as verification_status 'reproduced', may support level 3. is_prediction labels model output (docking, simulation, structure prediction) as a prediction in the record itself, at filing time (LABORATORY section 6 rule 6), so a prediction can never be quietly read as a measurement.

data_source.description: Where the information came from, with a locator (DOI, dataset row range, passage) wherever the source has one.

evidence_level.description: The evidence ladder level (LABORATORY section 7) this experiment's result supports. Capped at 3 in this schema: levels 4 to 6 require physical experiments and external replication and cannot be granted by this system. Further capped by verification_status through the allOf rules: unverified or mismatch caps at 2.

execution_logs.description: Execution log lines or log artifact refs, including errors and warnings.

hypothesis_id.description: The hypothesis record this experiment tests.

hypothesis_version.description: Exactly which version of the hypothesis was tested.

id.description: Unique experiment identifier in this lab.

input_hash.description: Content hash of the archived inputs. Confirms the input has not silently changed; the verifier re-executes from these inputs.

is_prediction.description: True when the output is a model prediction (docking score, simulation output, structure prediction) rather than a measurement or a reproduction of published work. Labelled in the record itself, never only in prose.

model.description: Which AI model proposed the task, and its version.

original_data.description: Reference to the original data that went into the experiment (artifact ref, dataset id, or archived input set).

output_hash.description: Content hash identifying the resulting artifact. Null when the run failed before producing an output artifact; the failure is still recorded.

parameters.description: All calculation settings, complete enough to re-run the job exactly.

random_seed.description: Reproducibility seed for stochastic calculations. The key must be present; null is accepted only when the calculation is deterministic and uses no seed (the repo's present-but-null convention, as in js/schema.js).

software.description: What performed the calculation, and its version.

verification_status.description: Whether another agent independently reproduced this result from the archived inputs: unverified (not yet), reproduced (independent re-execution matched), mismatch (re-execution did not match; the finding is stopped at its level).

title: Science Lab experiment record
